## Block Markup

This is a **hybrid block**. It saves static markup that the server may enhance during rendering.

```html
<!-- wp:form-input {"type":"text","label":"Label","inlineLabel":false,"required":false,"value":"","visibilityPermissions":"all"} -->
<!-- Content... -->
<!-- /wp:form-input -->
```
